test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 04 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In 1987, an Action Research Program was started by NABARD with ______, based on which a pilot project was launched to link 500 Self Help Groups (SHGs) with banks.
solution:
The correct answer is __**MYRADA.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **MYRADA (Mysore Resettlement and Development Agency):-**

 
 
• It is a non-governmental organization that focuses on poverty alleviation and rural development.
 
• **It was one of the partners in the pilot project launched by NABARD in 1987, which aimed to promote financial inclusion through the formation of SHGs and their linkage with banks. **
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **PFRDA (Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority):-**

 
 
• It is a statutory body that regulates and promotes pension schemes in India. 
 
 
 
• **IREDA (Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency):-**
 
 
• It is a financial institution that provides loans and funding for renewable energy projects. 
 
 
 
• **AMFI (Association of Mutual Funds in India):-**
 
 
• It is a trade association of mutual funds in India.
